title: Report lost delivery state at session start
body:
Outcome: the session-start restart block prints `STATE LOSS: <expected path>` when an open claim names a worktree, or a recorded successor launch exists, and no capsule or handoff resolves.
Evidence: scripts/claude/context-restart.ts:48-106; the 2026-11-02 deletion of 21 .krn/runs directories went unreported by `krn state check`; .krn/runs/program-audit/synthesis.md.
